summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 22, 2026, announcing an Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for May 29, 2026. The filing includes the notice of meeting, circular, and proxy form. The board recommends voting in favor of proposed resolutions. This is a routine procedural filing for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement for an annual meeting. No special situation is indicated; the filing merely informs shareholders of the meeting and voting procedures. There are no deal terms, as this is not a transactional event.
